notes: The list writes three waws and the ASV three connectives (both, and, and), so the count runs one to one under rules 14 and 42; no correlative pair is being rendered by a single morpheme here.

לְאֵין מַשָּׂא is recast as more than they could carry away; the frame is given to the existential and the noun keeps the verb, with the preposition unrepresented (rules 40, 50). The competing head on more is named in the unit's note.
The intensive so is given to כִּי as the only English the ASV spends on that particle; the competing reading (particle unrepresented, so with the adjective) is named in the unit's note.
